items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: Well, Felice Crencini used to love to hear him play that

ctx.x: D clarinet. D, I don't believe I ever saw a D.

It's a heavy toned instrument, like the A clarinet. Yes. And the C clarinet is probably supposed to be mostly a youngster that is trying. A very toned, very soft toned instrument, the C clarinet. Then you got the E flat clarinet with a high, very high pitch. Did you know that? Yes. The E flat has a very high pitch. Now the D clarinet, they have a very deep tone and it has also a little bell on the part of it. Like an outdoor. Like an outdoor. Yeah, that's a D clarinet. Yeah. Well he had one also. Yeah. My brother…
I suppose they were Saturday night, wasn't it? Yeah. I wondered if you ever knew about what strength of reed Lorenzo would use. Would he use a medium or a hard, a soft reed?
